description: Port the server listens on
Logging verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn or error
Log filter for dependencies, in RUST_LOG syntax. Empty uses the log level for everything
PostgreSQL connection string
URL the server uses to reach the integrated daemon. The published Docker Compose file sets it to http://host.docker.internal:60073
Mark session cookies Secure, so browsers send them over HTTPS only. Set it when the UI is served over HTTPS
Turn off sign-up for new users
Turn off email and password login, leaving OIDC as the only way to sign in
Username for the SMTP relay
Password for the SMTP relay
Sender address for email Scanopy sends over SMTP
SMTP relay host, for example smtp.gmail.com
SMTP relay port. 465 uses implicit TLS; any other port uses STARTTLS
URL users reach the server at. Used in password reset links, invite links and webhooks
Where the server reads the client IP from when it sits behind a reverse proxy, for accurate IPs in auth event logs. Unset uses the connecting address
OIDC providers users can sign in with
Bearer token the Prometheus metrics endpoint requires
PEM file of extra CA certificates to trust for outbound TLS, in addition to the bundled roots

Serve the web UI from this directory instead of the copy compiled into the binary. The Docker image sets it to /app/static. If the directory has no readable index.html, the server logs a warning and serves the compiled-in UI
License key for the commercial edition. Omit it for the community edition
Email address shown to users who can't create an organization because the server has reached its organization limit
Days to keep topology snapshots before pruning them. Unset uses the plan's retention window
